notes.subject: yo a khohloganago le yo a khohlelago
notes.rationale: שגג/משגה: KJV e bitša 'deceived and deceiver'; mantšu a mabedi a bolela 'go tsela/go khohloga' — mošomo le motho a fetolego maano; phetolelo ya Sesotho e swanetše go boloka bothata bjo.

notes.subject: שגג / משגה
notes.rationale: Lesoko la mantšu a mabedi a theilwego godimo ga שגה — modu o tee o bolela botho le mošomiši; go se kgone go sebolwa ka Sepedi.

translation: Go yena go na le maatla le bohlale bja nnete; go yena ke yo a khohloganago le yo a khohlelago.
